subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter -cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

TEMPERATURE : VFNRFTBVVTF :: RESIDENTIAL :?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06c01734f8aa4c011a0a36a57e3bea6aebf56189f0aedd590f9d0d65a852ad3.png] 

The logic follows here is:-

**The alphabets with e**ven positional values **are increased by 2. **

The alphabets with **o****dd positional values are increased by 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55d323daeaef495e339f06accac9f0d1fe35f05e13bcd3a2fad5eea1a5fbaa4b.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37d9fe1dd8bc139568d87350643bf7a8c4b15020803ae40d1d728ece9e3add04.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TFTJFFPVJBN".**
